meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 为NanoClaw组添加并维护一个基于Karpathy LLM Wiki模式的持久化Wiki知识库，包含wiki目录、容器技能和组CLAUDE.md，执行摄入、查询、检查操作。处理文件时逐个进行，避免批量处理。
howto.when: 当用户说出“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”等关键词时触发，或用户想为NanoClaw组设置持久化Wiki时。

say.text: 给主群添加一个关于机器学习的wiki。
say.note: 启动添加Wiki流程，Claude会引导你设计与配置。

say.text: 在我的wiki组中摄入这个PDF文件。
say.note: 触发摄入操作，Claude逐个处理并更新Wiki页面。

howto.what_en: Adds and maintains a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Creates wiki directories, container skill, and group CLAUDE.md. Executes ingest, query, and lint operations. Processes files one by one to avoid shallow pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or when user wants to set up a persistent wiki for a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki about machine learning to the main group.
say_en.note: Starts the add-wiki process; Claude guides you through design and setup.

say_en.text: Ingest this PDF file into my wiki group.
say_en.note: Triggers ingestion; Claude processes it and updates wiki pages one by one.
